text:
Maya J: Quick proposal: standardize postmortem follow-ups into a tiny ticket template + 2-week timebox. Keeps owners honest and makes trends easier to query.

Liam R: Strong yes. Minimal fields? Owner + backup, ETA, verification, recurrence tag, blocking-deps.

Maya J: Exact. Example ticket body: 
```
Owner: Maya J (primary), Liam R (backup)
ETA: 2026-05-02
Verify: p95 latency < 200ms for 48h
Recurrence: 3 in 6mo
Blocking: infra upgrade (ENG-INFRA)
2w-timebox: yes
```

Ola N: Add "blast radius" and "rollback window" please. Also require a 1-line comms snippet for execs.

Liam R: For IC rotation, let's pair ICs for 2-week handoffs: week A leads, week B shadows and closes follow-ups. Post rotation, backup becomes lead next rotation.

pager-bot: Reminder created: 2w-remediation-standup Tue 10:00 starting 1824004800

Maya J: Ops cadence suggestion: D0 incident channel, D1 postmortem + create tickets, Week1 15-min sync, Week2 final review + escalate long items to roadmap with PM owner.

Ola N: Can someone own the ticket-to-board automation? If we auto-create minimal cards from postmortems it's much lower friction.

Liam R: I'll prototype a small GitHub Action that posts a ticket to the board when a postmortem uses the "2w-timebox: yes" tag. Due in 1 week.

Maya J: Actions:
- Liam R: prototype automation (1w)
- Ola N: draft comms snippet + verification checklist (3d)
- Maya J: update playbook with IC rotation notes and cadence (4d)

Ola N: I'll drop templates in #eng-oncall.

Liam R: +1

Maya J: Thanks all — will follow up once automation is live.
